title: Gateway and moving light
slide_intent: Use movement around a physical product to suggest an invisible service while keeping the physical object easy to identify.
strategic_value: Light spreading from the gateway can give Xfinity’s connectivity a visible, repeatable expression.
demonstration: A pale gateway rotates on a reflective colored floor while bands and pools of colored light extend around its base.
practical_value: Keep the product silhouette steady enough to recognize while using light to carry the story of connectivity.

content_islands.name: Gateway specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the pale tower near the center with its top grille and side surfaces visible.

content_islands.name: Light field
content_islands.spec: Move bands and pools of light across the floor and change the surrounding hue, retaining the product’s reflection.

ingredient.name: Projected light
ingredient.role: Make an invisible connection perceptible around the gateway.
ingredient.application: Animate light across the stage around the hardware, preserving the light product silhouette against the saturated field.
ingredient.scope: Observed motion treatment in the case study; no production timing or hardware behavior is specified.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case-study text explains light and color as expressions of the emotions and possibilities of connectivity.
reference_purposes.Expression: Colored light moves outward around a gateway as the stage shifts hue.
reference_purposes.Application: The animation applies the light treatment to a specific physical product.
